# Defining Minimum Viable Product

## Core principle

Identify the smallest end-to-end product that tests the product thesis rather than a pile of disconnected features. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a mature product requiring full release scope
- a prototype whose learning question is still unknown
